name: QA Form Recaller
description: Record what you fill into any web form — text, selects, checkboxes, radios, dates, textareas, rich-text editors — save it as a named recipe, edit the values, and replay them into the form with one click.
features: 📥 Snapshot: one click captures every filled field on the page into a new recipe (Alt+Shift+R)
⏺ Record: watch the form as you fill it — fields are captured in the order you touch them, so dependent dropdowns replay correctly
▶ Play: refills the whole form in one click (Alt+Shift+P replays the last recipe used on this page) and reports which fields were filled or not found
✏️ Editor: rename recipes, change any value, remove fields, set the delay between fields, and duplicate a recipe for a variant (e.g. same order form, different customer)

🎯 Robust field matching — id, name, data-testid, aria-label, placeholder, label text, then CSS path — so recipes survive minor page changes; framework inputs (React/Angular/Vue) get real input/change events
🌐 Recipes are grouped by page URL; passwords are skipped unless you opt in; export/import recipes as JSON to share with the team
